title: Vapour pressure of water
caption: Vapour pressure rises steeply with temperature. A liquid boils when its vapour pressure equals the pressure above it: 101.3 kPa at 100 °C for water at sea level, lower on a mountain, so water boils at a lower temperature there.
alt: Vapour pressure of water against temperature, a curve rising steeply to 101.3 kPa at 100 °C, with a dashed line marking atmospheric pressure.
description: Vapour pressure is small at 20 °C (about 2.3 kPa).
It reaches 101.3 kPa, atmospheric pressure, at 100 °C: the normal boiling point.

checks.name: vapour pressure reaches 1 atm at 100 °C (Antoine equation)
